config.name: braveApiKey
config.description: Your Brave Search subscription token. Get one at [api-dashboard.search.brave.com](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/keys).

tools.name: brave_web_search
tools.description: Performs web searches using the Brave Search API and returns comprehensive search results with rich metadata. To chain into local-POI enrichment, pass `result_filter=locations` and feed the resulting `locations.results[].id` values into `brave_local_search`. To chain into the AI summarizer, pass `summary=true` and feed the returned `summarizer.key` into `brave_summarizer`.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query (max 400 characters and 50 words).

params.name: count
params.description: Number of results to return (max 20; default 20).

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system used in result content.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (max 9, in units of `count`).

params.name: country
params.description: 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to US.

params.name: summary
params.description: Set to true to request a summarizer key in the response. Pair with `brave_summarizer` to fetch the AI-generated summary text. Pro AI tier required.

params.name: ui_lang
params.description: User interface language for the response, in the form <lang>-<country> (e.g. en-US).

params.name: freshness
params.description: Filter results by recency. Use pd (past day), pw (past week), pm (past month), py (past year), or a YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD range.

params.name: goggles_id
params.description: Goggles ID for re-ranked results. See https://search.brave.com/help/goggles.

params.name: safesearch
params.description: Filter level for adult content.

params.name: spellcheck
params.description: Whether to spellcheck the query.

params.name: search_lang
params.description: 2-letter language code for the search. Defaults to en.

tools.name: brave_local_search
tools.description: Brave Local Search API returns enriched information (address, phone, hours, rating) for location-search results. Access requires the Brave Search API Pro plan; currently US-only. Two-step flow: first call `brave_web_search` with `result_filter=locations` to obtain `locations.results[].id`, then pass them here. NOTE: This tool takes location IDs from a prior web-search response; if you have a free-text query, call `brave_web_search` first.

params.name: ids
params.description: One or more location IDs returned by a prior `brave_web_search` with `result_filter=locations`. Up to 20 IDs per call.

params.name: units
params.description: Measurement system.

params.name: ui_lang
params.description: User interface language for the response, in the form <lang>-<country> (e.g. en-US).

params.name: search_lang
params.description: 2-letter language code for the search. Defaults to en.

tools.name: brave_llm_context
tools.description: Retrieves pre-extracted, relevance-ranked web content using Brave's LLM Context API, optimized for AI agents, LLM grounding, and RAG pipelines. Unlike a traditional web search that returns links and short descriptions, this tool returns the actual substance of matching pages — text chunks, tables, code blocks, and structured data — so the model can reason over it directly. When relaying results in markdown-supporting environments, cite source URLs from the `sources` map.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of search results considered to select the LLM context data. Default 20, max 50.

params.name: query
params.description: The user's search query. Max 400 characters and 50 words.

params.name: country
params.description: 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to US.

params.name: freshness
params.description: Filter results by recency. Use pd, pw, pm, py, or YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: spellcheck
params.description: Whether to spellcheck the query.

params.name: search_lang
params.description: 2-letter language code for the search. Defaults to en.

params.name: enable_local
params.description: Whether to enable local recall.

params.name: context_threshold_mode
params.description: Mode used to determine the inclusion threshold for content.

params.name: enable_source_metadata
params.description: Enable source metadata enrichment (site_name, favicon) in the sources attribute.

params.name: maximum_number_of_urls
params.description: Maximum number of different URLs to include in LLM context.

params.name: maximum_number_of_tokens
params.description: Approximate maximum number of tokens to include in context. Default 8192, max 32768.

params.name: maximum_number_of_snippets
params.description: Maximum number of snippets (chunks of text) to include in LLM context. Default 50, max 256.

tools.name: brave_place_search
tools.description: Searches Brave's Place Search API. A single call may populate any combination of `results` (POIs), `cities`, `addresses`, `streets`, and `location` (the resolved search area), depending on the query shape. Use for POIs near coordinates or a named area, browsing general POIs (omit `query`, supply coords or `location`), disambiguating bare city names, resolving specific addresses, or looking up streets. Anchor via `latitude`+`longitude` or `location`; with neither, `query` is required.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of results (max 50, default 20).

params.name: query
params.description: Query string. Shape influences the response: POI-like queries return `results`; ambiguous city names return `cities`; address-/street-shaped queries with a geographic anchor return `addresses` and/or

params.name: units
params.description: Units of measurement for distance values.

params.name: geoloc
params.description: Optional geolocation token used to refine results.

params.name: radius
params.description: Bias toward results closer to the supplied coordinates, in meters. NOT a hard cutoff.

params.name: country
params.description: 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Defaults to US.

params.name: ui_lang
params.description: User interface language for the response, in the form <lang>-<country> (e.g. en-US).

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the geographical coordinates to search around (-90 to 90). Typically paired with `longitude`.

params.name: location
params.description: Location string used as an alternative to lat/long. US: '<city> <state> <country>' (e.g. 'san francisco ca united states'). Non-US: '<city> <country>' (e.g. 'tokyo japan'). Capitalization and commas d

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the geographical coordinates to search around (-180 to 180). Typically paired with `latitude`.

tools.name: brave_summarizer
tools.description: Retrieves AI-generated summaries of web search results. Two-step flow: first call `brave_web_search` with `summary=true` to obtain `summarizer.key`, then pass it here. Pro AI tier required.

params.name: key
params.description: Summarizer key returned by a prior `brave_web_search` with `summary=true`.

params.name: entity_info
params.description: Whether to include extra entity-info fields with citation metadata.
